labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: Annotation of cell types included in dataset based on prior knowledge.

labels.name: Hepatocytes
labels.rationale: The marker genes provided are the top 10 DEGs for this cluster (from Table S3 from the publication). On the basis of these genes, other top DEGs and expression of ALB and TTR we annotated these cells as hepatocytes. They can be further subdivided into portal and central hepatocytes.

labels.name: Cholangiocytes
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with other cell types in UMAP (from Table S3 in publication).

labels.name: Portal Vein Endothelial cells
labels.fullName: endothelial cell of hepatic portal vein
labels.ontologyTerm: endothelial cell of hepatic portal vein
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs between this population and the others in the UMAP (from Table S3 in publication). Other key genes were VWF, DLL4 and NRG3.

labels.name: LSECs
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for these cells compared with other cells in the UMAP (from Table S3 in publication). Other key genes in list of DEGs used to define these cells include LYVE1, KDR and FLT1.

labels.name: Central Vein Endothelial cells
labels.fullName: endothelial cell of central vein of liver
labels.ontologyTerm: endothelial cell of central vein of liver
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with all other cell types in the UMAP (from Table S3 in publication).

labels.name: Fibroblasts
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this cell population compared with the rest (from Table S3 in publication).

labels.name: Stellate cells
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for these cells compared with other cells in the UMAP (from Table S3 in publication). Other canonical marker genes used include DCN and various collagen genes.

labels.name: VSMCs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this cell population compared with others in this UMAP (from Table S3 in publication).
